tools.name: get_issue_details
tools.description:
Retrieve and analyze a Sentry issue by ID or URL. Use this tool when you need to:
- Investigate a specific production error
- Get stacktraces and related events
- Understand when an issue first and last occurred

<examples>
### Get details for a specific issue
```
get_issue_details(organizationSlug='my-organization', issueId='PROJECT-123')
```
</examples>

<hints>
- If the user provides an issueUrl, you can omit organizationSlug and issueId.
</hints>

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations in the `find_organizations()` tool.

issueUrl.description: The URL of the issue. e.g. https://my-organization.sentry.io/issues/PROJECT-1Z43

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description:
Search for grouped issues/problems in Sentry. Returns a list of issues with their metadata.

Use this tool when you need to search for issues matching a natural-language query. DO NOT use this for individual events; use `search_events` for that.

naturalLanguageQuery.description: Natural language description of issues to search for, e.g. 'unresolved errors from the last 24 hours'

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an issue's status or assignment in Sentry. Be careful: resolving an issue hides it from the default view.
